elements.name: X1

geometry_model.validation_basis: reference device calibration does not validate external BG/B dynamics
geometry_model.surface_recombination_fraction: assumed 100% of the effective junction-SRH term; not independently extracted
geometry_model.backgate_coupling: delta_psi = Cb/(Cf+Cb) * VBG; effective BJT source injection P = ni^2 * exp(delta_psi/VT) * expm1(u/VT)
geometry_model.backgate_assumption: uncalibrated lumped electrostatic BJT body-bias closure; no separate back-channel or 2D Poisson solution
geometry_model.body_potential: psi_body = u - VT*ln(1+delta_inj/Nbody) + delta_psi; body contact voltage is u, not psi_body
geometry_model.drain_field_approximation: original r-based collector field retained; no independent backgate-induced drain-field correction
geometry_model.body_capacitance_scaling: Cf + Cb - Cb0; Cb0 is reference-calibration counterterm

elements.folds_scope: intrinsic floating-body reference; not thresholds of the externally body-loaded or modulated circuit

oscillator.scope: body-loaded dynamics require transient integration; intrinsic quasi-static walk used only for a rough work estimate

warnings: X1: B is an ideal hole contact, V(B)-V(S)=u. Free-body fold estimates do not predict a body-loaded circuit's switching voltages.

no DC operating point was found from the empty body (a current-biased cell forced beyond its HRS): the transient starts from discharged capacitors, as if the sources were switched on at t = 0 (tran.initial = 'auto')
